  global.SAMGUK_EUMNU_MAP_DATA_V136=Object.freeze(EUMNU_DATA);
  global.SAMGUK_EUMNU_MAP_DATA_V135=global.SAMGUK_EUMNU_MAP_DATA_V136;

  function findTerritoryIndexByName(name){
    return world.territories.findIndex(t=>String(t?.name||'')===String(name));
  }

  function applyBaseEumnuOverrides(){
    const overrides=EUMNU_DATA.baseTerritoryOverrides||{};
    for(const [name,patch] of Object.entries(overrides)){
      const i=findTerritoryIndexByName(name);
      if(i<0)continue;
      const t=world.territories[i];
      if(Number.isFinite(Number(patch.x)))t.x=Number(patch.x);
      if(Number.isFinite(Number(patch.y)))t.y=Number(patch.y);
      if(typeof patch.path==='string'&&patch.path.trim())t.path=patch.path;
      t.mapGeometryRevision='v136-eumnu-coast';
    }
  }

  // Apply before rebuilding the land silhouette so the removed blue area cannot remain
  // in the old BASE_LAND_PATH as a hidden stale polygon.
  applyBaseEumnuOverrides();

  const START_INDEX=world.territories.length;
  const waterSet=new Set(Array.isArray(world.waterTerritoryIds)?world.waterTerritoryIds.map(Number):[]);
  const BASE_LAND_PATH=world.territories.map((t,i)=>{
    if(!t||t.inactive||waterSet.has(i))return '';
    return typeof t.path==='string'?t.path:'';
  }).join('');

  const NON_JAPAN_TERRITORIES=[
    // v135: old 읍루 극동 북부 / 읍루 동북 해안 / 읍루 극동 중부 are deliberately gone.
    // Only the right-most guide territory remains as '읍루 동해안'.
    ...EUMNU_DATA.expansionTerritories.map(t=>({...t,resources:Array.isArray(t.resources)?t.resources.slice():[]})),

    // 동진 / 강남 확장 — unchanged from v132/v134.
    {id:'dongjin_jiangnan_west',name:'동진 강남 서부',x:-116,y:1169,home:10,terrainType:'plain',resources:['rice'],path:'M-180,1120L-118,1138L-60,1145L-70,1190L-115,1210L-180,1190Z'},
    {id:'dongjin_jiangnan_central',name:'동진 강남 중부',x:-8,y:1171,home:10,terrainType:'plain',resources:['silk'],path:'M-60,1145L32,1145L74,1138L78,1185L35,1215L-20,1205L-70,1190Z'},
    {id:'dongjin_jiangnan_east',name:'동진 강남 동부',x:139,y:1174,home:10,terrainType:'plain',resources:['salt'],path:'M74,1138L168,1145L220,1160L205,1205L150,1222L78,1185Z'},
    {id:'dongjin_southsea_west',name:'동진 남해 서부',x:-121,y:1235,home:10,terrainType:'plain',resources:['rice'],path:'M-180,1190L-115,1210L-70,1190L-55,1240L-80,1260L-180,1260Z'},
    {id:'dongjin_southsea_central',name:'동진 남해 중부',x:-7,y:1237,home:10,terrainType:'plain',resources:['silk'],path:'M-70,1190L-20,1205L35,1215L45,1260L-80,1260L-55,1240Z'},
    {id:'dongjin_southsea_east',name:'동진 남해 동부',x:137,y:1240,home:10,terrainType:'plain',resources:['salt'],path:'M35,1215L150,1222L205,1205L220,1245L200,1260L45,1260Z'}
  ];

  const TERRITORIES=[...NON_JAPAN_TERRITORIES,...japan.territories.map(t=>({...t,resources:Array.isArray(t.resources)?t.resources.slice():[]}))];

  const NON_JAPAN_LAND_LINKS=[
    ...EUMNU_DATA.landLinks.map(pair=>pair.slice()),
    ['서주','동진 강남 서부'],['동진 서부','동진 강남 서부'],['동진 남부','동진 강남 서부'],
    ['동진 남부','동진 강남 중부'],['동진 남동','동진 강남 중부'],['동진 남동','동진 강남 동부'],
    ['동진 연안','동진 강남 동부'],['동진 강남 서부','동진 강남 중부'],['동진 강남 중부','동진 강남 동부'],
    ['동진 강남 서부','동진 남해 서부'],['동진 강남 중부','동진 남해 중부'],['동진 강남 동부','동진 남해 동부'],
    ['동진 남해 서부','동진 남해 중부'],['동진 남해 중부','동진 남해 동부']
  ];

  const LAND_LINKS=[...NON_JAPAN_LAND_LINKS,...japan.landLinks.map(pair=>pair.slice())];
  const SEA_LINKS=japan.seaLinks.map(pair=>pair.slice());
  const TERRAIN_RULES=TERRITORIES.map(()=>({kind:'plain',river:false}));

  function routeKey(a,b){return [Number(a),Number(b)].sort((x,y)=>x-y).join('-')}
  function nameMap(){return new Map(world.territories.map((t,i)=>[String(t?.name||''),i]))}
  function ensureNeighborSlot(){while(world.neighbors.length<world.territories.length)world.neighbors.push([])}
  function addNeighbor(a,b){
    if(!Number.isInteger(a)||!Number.isInteger(b)||a<0||b<0||a===b)return false;
    ensureNeighborSlot();
    if(!world.neighbors[a].includes(b))world.neighbors[a].push(b);
    if(!world.neighbors[b].includes(a))world.neighbors[b].push(a);
    world.neighbors[a].sort((x,y)=>x-y);
    world.neighbors[b].sort((x,y)=>x-y);
    return true;
  }
  function addSeaRoute(a,b){
    if(!Array.isArray(world.seaRoutes))world.seaRoutes=[];
    const key=routeKey(a,b);
    if(!world.seaRoutes.some(pair=>Array.isArray(pair)&&pair.length>=2&&routeKey(pair[0],pair[1])===key)){
      world.seaRoutes.push([Math.min(a,b),Math.max(a,b)]);
    }
    return addNeighbor(a,b);
  }
  function addNamedLinks(links,sea=false){
    const ids=nameMap();
    for(const [from,to] of links){
      const a=ids.get(from),b=ids.get(to);
      if(!Number.isInteger(a)||!Number.isInteger(b))continue;
      if(sea)addSeaRoute(a,b);else addNeighbor(a,b);
    }
  }

  for(const entry of TERRITORIES){
    if(world.territories.some(t=>String(t?.id||'')===entry.id||String(t?.name||'')===entry.name))continue;
    world.territories.push({
      id:entry.id,name:entry.name,x:entry.x,y:entry.y,home:entry.home,path:entry.path,
      resources:Array.isArray(entry.resources)?entry.resources.slice():[],terrainType:entry.terrainType||null,mapExpansion:'v136'
    });
    world.neighbors.push([]);
  }

  // SVG/Canvas land silhouette uses the corrected base polygons + expansion polygons only.
  // This removes the old blue coastal wedge physically instead of painting sea over stale land.
  world.baseLandPath=BASE_LAND_PATH;
  world.landPath=BASE_LAND_PATH+TERRITORIES.map(t=>t.path).join('');

  addNamedLinks(LAND_LINKS,false);
  addNamedLinks(SEA_LINKS,true);

  const seaSet=new Set((world.seaRoutes||[]).map(pair=>routeKey(pair[0],pair[1])));
  for(let i=0;i<world.territories.length;i++){
    const territory=world.territories[i];
    const connected=Array.isArray(world.neighbors[i])?world.neighbors[i].slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b):[];
    territory.connectedRoutes=connected;
    territory.connectedSeaRoutes=connected.filter(j=>seaSet.has(routeKey(i,j)));
  }

  world.minX=Math.min(Number.isFinite(Number(world.minX))?Number(world.minX):-180.5,-180.5);
  world.minY=Math.min(Number.isFinite(Number(world.minY))?Number(world.minY):-.5,-.5);
  world.width=Math.max(Number(world.width)||0,1301.25);
  world.height=Math.max(Number(world.height)||0,1271.0);
  world.expandedBounds=Object.freeze({minX:-180.5,minY:-.5,maxX:1120.75,maxY:1270.5,width:1301.25,height:1271.0});
  world.__mapExpansionV125Applied=true;

  function territoryId(name){return nameMap().get(String(name))}
  function canMoveSeaRoute(a,b){
    const x=Number(a),y=Number(b);
    if(!Number.isInteger(x)||!Number.isInteger(y)||x===y)return false;
    if(!world.territories[x]||!world.territories[y])return false;
    return seaSet.has(routeKey(x,y));
  }
  function connectedRoutes(id){
    const i=Number(id);
    return Number.isInteger(i)&&Array.isArray(world.neighbors[i])?world.neighbors[i].slice():[];
  }
  function appendTerrainRules(target){
    if(!target||!Array.isArray(target.areas))return false;
    for(let i=0;i<TERRAIN_RULES.length;i++){
      const targetIndex=START_INDEX+i;
      if(!target.areas[targetIndex])target.areas[targetIndex]={...TERRAIN_RULES[i]};
    }
    while(target.areas.length<world.territories.length)target.areas.push({kind:'plain',river:false});
    return true;
  }

  global.SAMGUK_MAP_EXPANSION_V125=Object.freeze({
    version:136,startIndex:START_INDEX,addedCount:world.territories.length-START_INDEX,
    territoryNames:Object.freeze(TERRITORIES.map(t=>t.name)),
    landLinks:Object.freeze(LAND_LINKS.map(x=>Object.freeze(x.slice()))),
    seaLinks:Object.freeze(SEA_LINKS.map(x=>Object.freeze(x.slice()))),
    terrainRules:Object.freeze(TERRAIN_RULES.map(x=>Object.freeze({...x}))),
    geometryRevision:'v136-eumnu-north-fill-red-coast-sea-cut',
    removedEumnuIds:Object.freeze(EUMNU_DATA.removedExpansionTerritories.map(x=>x.id)),
    removedEumnuNames:Object.freeze(EUMNU_DATA.removedExpansionTerritories.map(x=>x.name)),
    territoryId,canMoveSeaRoute,connectedRoutes,appendTerrainRules,bounds:world.expandedBounds
  });
})(window);

========================================================================================
FILE: PATCH_NOTES_v136.txt
========================================================================================
[삼국쟁패 v136 패치 노트]
기준 버전: v135

[요청 반영]
1. 빨간색 부분 바다 편입
- 읍루 동해안의 우측 하단 육지 꼬리/쐐기 영역을 실제 polygon에서 삭제했습니다.
- world.landPath 재생성 시 삭제된 면적이 들어가지 않으므로 단순 바다색 덮기가 아니라 실제 Sea 공간이 됩니다.
- 절삭 후 더 이상 직접 맞닿지 않는 '연해주 남부 ↔ 읍루 동해안' 육상 neighbor 연결도 제거했습니다.

2. 주황색 부분 연해주 북부 편입
- 북쪽 맵 경계의 빈 틈을 연해주 북부 polygon에 추가했습니다.
- 기존 (1065,0) → (969.5,11) 사선을 (1065,0) → (969.5,0) → (969.5,11)로 바꿔 상단 빈 육지 띠를 꽉 채웁니다.

3. 비영향 범위
- 숙신 고토와 연해주 남부의 기존 geometry는 변경하지 않았습니다.
- 일본/동진 확장 데이터도 수정하지 않았습니다.
